_comment: Cosmetics (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, Cosmetics). Titles, and the badges that mean something, are earned by what they mean - a level, being a Supporter or a Founder. Everything else costs keys, which every level pays (progression.json, keys). Every slot here is drawn by the game (src/render/looks.ts and battlefield.ts); live is the release switch - a slot set to false is shown as coming soon, cannot be unlocked, and its keys come off the top level, so a slot can be finished long before it is released. The fortress, the trail, the floor and the victory are seen by everyone in a match; a battlefield is how the board looks on the player's own screen. A cosmetic never changes anything §14.2 spends on information: silhouette is armor, fill is damage type, size and pips are mark, and none of those are for sale.
